Date to Roman Numerals

Write any date in Roman numerals — day, month and year converted with proper subtractive notation.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick any calendar date.
  2. Press Convert.
  3. Read the date in Roman numerals: day · month · year.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Does it use subtractive notation (IV not IIII)?

Yes — subtractive notation is used throughout: 4 = IV, 9 = IX, 40 = XL, 90 = XC, 400 = CD, 900 = CM.

What about years above 3999?

Standard Roman numerals cover 1–3999, so any realistic calendar year works. Years above 3999 have no standard form.

What format is the output?

DD · MM · YYYY, e.g. 14-02-2026 becomes XIV · II · MMXXVI.
